newsitem.title: USA: Polaris boosts dividend, to buy back stock.
newsitem.headline: Polaris boosts dividend, to buy back stock.

text.p: Polaris Industries Inc said Thursday its directors voted to increase the company's quarterly dividend to $0.16 per share, up seven percent from the $0.15 previous rate.
The cash dividend is payable February 17, 1997 to shareholders of record on February 6, 1997.

Polaris also said its directors approved expansion of an existing share repurchase program initiated in January 1996 by authorizing the repurchase of up to a total of three million shares of Polaris common stock, up from the previous one million shares. Of the previous one million total, about 500,000 shares have been repurchased to date.
Polaris designs, engineers, makes and markets snowmobiles, all-terrain vehicles and personal watercraft for recreational and utility use.
Shares of Polaris were trading up 1/8 to 24-1/4.
